Job Details

NTU College of Engineering

Emerging Scholars Forum 2027 | 19-20 January 2027 | Singapore

The College of Engineering (CoE) at Nanyang Technological University (NTU) Singapore invites outstanding senior graduate students and postdoctoral fellows from around the world to apply for the Emerging Scholars Forum 2027. This exclusive platform offers the chance to connect with leading academics, explore collaborative opportunities, and gain valuable insights into one of the world’s top engineering colleges.

This interdisciplinary forum will bring together exceptional early-career researchers in Engineering and Chemistry to discuss cutting-edge research, experience NTU's vibrant academic environment, and network with peers and potential mentors. Selected participants will have their travel and accommodation expenses fully covered by NTU.

Who Should Apply

We welcome outstanding senior graduate students and postdoctoral fellows with expertise in all areas of Engineering and Chemistry, including but not limited to:

Chemistry, Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology (CCEB)

Biocatalysis, chemical biology, advanced spectroscopy, (bio)analytical & bioimaging technologies

Polymer science & engineering, process systems engineering & modelling, chemical reaction engineering, fluid dynamics & microfluidics

AI, machine learning & automation technologies for chemistry and chemical engineering

Nanotherapeutics, biomaterials, synthetic & systems biology, RNA/protein/vector engineering, regenerative medicine & tissue engineering

Medical devices & technology, translational ophthalmic engineering

Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE)

Coastal protection, geotechnical & structural engineering

Low-carbon materials, waste management, urban sustainability, environmental health

Digital construction, maritime studies & management

Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE)

Renewable energy, smart power grids & energy storage

Control & robotics, autonomous systems

Integrated circuit design, microelectronics & semiconductor devices, bioelectronics, quantum technologies

Signal & information processing, machine learning & AI

Next-gen wireless optical technologies, space-based communication systems, small satellite technologies

Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering (MAE)

Aerospace materials & structures, hybrid propulsion & electrification

Space technology: rocket propulsion, spacecraft design, dynamics & attitude control

Smart airport & aviation management

Surface engineering, metrology, precision engineering, metamorphic & digital manufacturing systems

Robotics, industrial AI, biomechanics

Marine, geothermal & nuclear energy, hydrogen & alternative energy technologies, carbon management, intelligent energy systems & urban sustainability

Materials Science and Engineering (MSE)

Materials chemistry, inorganic materials, future electronics

Materials for extreme environments, sustainable applications & food applications

AI approaches for materials, modelling & simulation, materials discovery, automated materials synthesis

Quantum materials & photonics, biomaterials

Renewable energy & catalysis

Why Join the Forum

Engage directly with world-class faculty and research leaders from NTU.

Explore career opportunities at NTU College of Engineering.

Present your research and participate in insightful discussions with fellow academics and faculty members.

Network internationally with a diverse group of engineering scholars.

Experience Singapore, a global innovation hub in Southeast Asia, known for its multicultural vibrancy and lush green spaces.

Application Process

Please submit:

Curriculum Vitae (CV)

Two representative research papers

Email your application to CoE-FacultyRecruit@ntu.edu.sg

Application Deadline: 30 November 2026

Only selected participants will be notified.

About NTU College of Engineering

The NTU College of Engineering (CoE) is one of the largest engineering colleges in the world, comprising five schools: School of Chemistry, Chemical Engineering and Biotechnology (CCEB); School of Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE); School of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE); School of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering (MAE); and School of Materials Science and Engineering (MSE). NTU is consistently ranked among the top universities globally and offers a collaborative, interdisciplinary research environment.
